ownership.runtime_run_id: Use the actual platform run ID when exposed; otherwise null plus reason. A locally generated execution_instance_id is not a runtime run ID.
ownership.before_each_write_and_create: Fresh-read registry and lock. Scheduled caller must be allowed by peers.<surface>.automation_ids; active_automation_id is the ordinary scheduled executor pointer, not a requirement that Work IDs equal the ordinary ID. Interactive caller must match foreground_owners.<surface>.session_id/epoch. Require unchanged route_generation, exact holder/acquired_at, unexpired lease and own item claim. A held generic chatgpt lock is foreign. Any mismatch stops the write/Create.
ownership.expired_lease: Reacquire only when allowed; expiry never clears a claim or proves that Create did not happen.
ownership.release: Release only the exact lease this execution acquired; do not release a replacement lease, even if expired.

Pause the old ordinary task after verified switch; retain its history. Never move a task to an arbitrary conversation through an unsupported API field.
